from java.util import Date
	from java.time import LocalDate, LocalTime, ZonedDateTime
	
	 # Get current date (today)
	def getLaborTimes(start, end):
	    # Get current date (today)
	    today = LocalDate.now()
	    tomorrow = today.plusDays(1)
	
	    # Get the time for 6:00 AM today
	    timeStart = ZonedDateTime.of(today, LocalTime.of(start, 0), ZonedDateTime.now().getZone())
	
	    # Get the time for 6:00 PM today
	    timeEnd = ZonedDateTime.of(tomorrow, LocalTime.of(end, 0), ZonedDateTime.now().getZone())
	
	    # Convert ZonedDateTime to java.util.Date format
	    timeStartJava = Date.from(timeStart.toInstant())
	    timeEndJava = Date.from(timeEnd.toInstant())
	
	    # Return both times
	    return timeStartJava, timeEndJava
	    
	self.custom.startDay, self.custom.endDay = getLaborTimes(6, 20)
	table=mes_core.schedule.scheduleTable("mes_core")
	tableWO=mes_core.workOrder.workOrderTable("mes_core")
	self.custom.schTable = table.selectAll()
	self.custom.woTable = tableWO.selectAll()

# Define a list of colors
	colors = [
		"#FFB3BA", "#FFDFBA", "#FFFFBA", "#BAFFC9", "#BAE1FF",
		"#D4A5A5", "#F7A5CF", "#FBCFEA", "#D4F4FA", "#A0CED9",
		"#FFB6C1", "#FADADD", "#FFD1DC", "#F0E1D6", "#F5C6A5",
		"#E6A1B5", "#C9A9A6", "#E3DAC9", "#E5E1A1", "#FBE7C6",
		"#D8D1C9", "#F7DFD4", "#D0F4DE", "#F4E1D2", "#F4C2C2",
		"#EFD3D7", "#FAD5D4", "#FCE7E1", "#FFDEAD", "#FFEFD5",
		"#FFF8DC", "#FAFAD2", "#FFFACD", "#F5F5DC", "#FAF0E6",
		"#FFF0F5", "#FDF5E6", "#FFE4E1", "#FFFAF0", "#FFFFF0",
		"#F0FFF0", "#E6E6FA", "#F0F8FF", "#F5FFFA", "#D8BFD8",
		"#E0FFFF", "#E6E6FA", "#FFDAB9", "#F5DEB3", "#F0E68C"
	]
	
	# List of orders (with duplicates)
	orders = self.view.custom.schTable.getColumnAsList(2)
	
	# Dictionary to map orders to colors
	orderColors = {}
	colorIndex = 0
	
	# Assign a color to each unique order
	for order in orders:
	    if order not in orderColors:
	        # If no more unique colors left, wrap around to the start of the color list
	        orderColors[order] = colors[colorIndex % len(colors)]
	        colorIndex += 1
	
	# Create a new list of (order, color) pairs to use in your UI or further processing
	return {order: orderColors[order] for order in orders}
